title: Omni Template
description: This mod adds a trim that you can swap with the overworld trims.
body:
# OmniTemplate

Tired of searching countless structures just to find a specific Armor Trim?

OmniTemplate adds a single item that lets you choose the Armor Trim template you want directly from an in-game menu.

## Features
Adds the Omni Template item.
Opens a simple GUI with multiple Armor Trim choices.
- Quickly access several vanilla Armor Trim templates:
  - Vex
  - Sentry
  - Wild
  - Dune
  - Shaper
  - Raiser
  - Wayfinder
  - Host
  - Ward
  - Silence
  - Coast
- Designed for players who want more freedom when customizing armor.
## Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
## Notes
This mod does not add new trims. It provides an easier way to obtain selected vanilla Armor Trim templates.
